assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The public site package does not contain an official polygon. Issue #846 records a possible mismatch between the provisional overall boundary and the heritage park location; the boundary is not used as a precise redline or heritage claim.
assumptions.impact: All boundary-derived design layers, figures and metrics must be recalculated when official or cleared geometry is available.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, rail assets, blue lines, heritage controls, building status, ownership, utility capacity, fire access and accessibility conditions are not supplied as authoritative spatial layers.
assumptions.impact: Road, building, public-space and phasing features are concept-level reference schemes only.
